rationale: The claim is explicitly scoped to EASA's Notice of Proposed Amendment (NPA 2025-07(B)) as proposed candidate material rather than an adopted decision or operationalized DAA approval. The supplied NPA text directly substantiates each enumerated element: operational domain (GM1 AI.150), system development assurance (AMC1 AI.150), supervised learning assurance (AMC2 AI.150), configuration and life-cycle data (AMC1/AMC2 AI.150), and continuous risk assessment with in-service monitoring (DS.AI.160, AMC1 AI.160(a)). The challenge regarding final adoption and application-specific operationalization is properly preserved by the claim's provisional status and stated scope limits.
evidence_locators: S-CHAL-002-R2 (NPA 2025-07 (B), PDF pp. 24–26, DS.AI.150, AMC1 AI.150, AMC2 AI.150)
limitations: Inspection is bounded to NPA 2025-07(B) proposed text; final EASA decision, comment-response document (CRD), and subsequent ED-324 adoption status remain to be tracked.
